datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Kenya to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data for 2020. Survey results were spatially mapped and classified into IPC scenarios representing different food insecurity severity phases, then distributed as geographic data (GeoJSON/KML) for each month.
